# Andreas Roet — andreasroet.de

> Dub techno producer and sound designer. Hardware live sets (Elektron Octatrack MK2, Analog Rytm MK1, Analog Four MK2, Syntakt), records, producer tools and free browser apps under the TechnoSupps brand.

## What this site offers
- Sample packs and preset packs for dub techno and techno production, sold via Gumroad: https://technosupps.gumroad.com
- Free browser-based producer apps (no install): https://andreasroet.de/apps
- Production tutorials (sound design, mixing, hardware and software workflow): https://andreasroet.de/blog
- Music: label releases (Dreiton, Deeptakt), self-published records (Bandcamp), live sets (SoundCloud): https://andreasroet.de/music
- A free community for dub techno producers (Discord): https://andreasroet.de/community

## Key pages
- Shop (sample & preset packs): https://andreasroet.de/shop
- Apps (free producer tools): https://andreasroet.de/apps
- Tutorials & Blog: https://andreasroet.de/blog
- Music: https://andreasroet.de/music
- About: https://andreasroet.de/about
- Socials & links: https://andreasroet.de/socials

## Free browser apps
- GeoSonic — geometric MIDI generator: turns mathematical patterns (Euclidean, Fibonacci, Lorenz, L-systems and more) into MIDI. https://andreasroet.de/apps/geosonic
- The Live Set Planner — plan and structure hardware live sets on one sheet. https://andreasroet.de/apps/live-set-planner
- Mandoline — auto-slice long audio takes into curated sample packs (coming soon). https://andreasroet.de/apps/mandoline
- Glitchworks — VHS and glitch VFX for visuals, in the browser. https://andreasroet.de/apps/glitchworks

## Topics covered in tutorials
Dub techno chord design, call and response arrangement, Elektron hardware (Syntakt, Analog Four, Octatrack) workflow, Serum 2 sound design, hardware live sets, sampling, mixing for dub techno.

## Style
Producer-to-producer, direct, no hype. Sounds and tools are built from real hardware used in the artist's own productions. English.
